messages:
Sara_Ops: kicking off a 48h staged repro on rack g2-17 — observed intermittent Xid 13 + ECC count creeping on GPU slot2. Repro script attached. Need thumbs on config before we run full soak.
aj: can you paste the exact error logs? Xid 13 sometimes means driver oom or pci link flaps.
Sara_Ops: pasted log snippet:
```
[2026-03-16T03:12:10Z] Xid 13 at gpu=2 pid=4123 op=cuLaunchKernel
[2026-03-16T03:12:10Z] ECC corrected errors ++ count=5->12
```
Also thermal looks normal, no ECC spikes before 2h mark.
linus: run `stress-ng --gpu 2 --timeout 4h` + our repro harness. Suggest enabling ECC scrubbing offload to catch pattern.
Sara_Ops: the repro uses `./soak_repro.sh --pattern=matrix-mul --iters=1e6 --kv-check` — want to add memtest?
kevin_r: add repeated context switch test and pci rescan loop: `for i in 1..1000; do nvidia-smi -q; sleep 2; done` sometimes triggers flakies.
infra-bot: quick note: we've got 5 other nodes in the pool with similar ECC growth in past week (query:gpu.health.ecc.growth > 3 in 7d) — flagged to eng-infra.
aj: for the staged run, set `power_limit` to stock and log pcie link status every 30s. If it's reproducible within 12h we can escalate to warranty/replace.
Sara_Ops: running now with additions. I'll push updated config to the soak job:
```
soak_config:
  duration: 48h
  workload: matrix-mul+kv
  monitor:
    - nvidia-smi -q -d ECC,PCI
    - perf counter capture every 5m
  retry: 3
```
linus: also capture `dmesg -w` to catch driver resets. If it hits Xid > 100 we need full daemon core.
Sara_Ops: noted. Will report back at 6h and 24h. tagging @kevin_r @aj
kevin_r: thumbs, also consider isolating to pcie bifurcation change if hardware team approves.
Sara_Ops: thanks. update: at 5h mark we saw ECC jump to 21 and one Xid 13. Reproduced once. I'll quarantine node from scheduler (drain) and continue soak.
aj: good call. keep logs in /var/log/gpu-soak/1798765432.log and attach incident ticket if it repeats.
